name: Old Fashioned
desc: Bourbon with demerara syrup and Angostura bitters over a large cube, with orange and cherry.

source.title: Old-Fashioned
source.evidence: Same bourbon, demerara sugar, 3 dashes Angostura bitters, expressed orange peel and Luxardo cherry garnish; The Kitchn uses 2 oz bourbon and stirs in a mixing glass.

steps: Add the syrup and bitters to a rocks glass.
Add the large ice cube and pour in the bourbon.
Stir for 20 to 30 seconds, until the glass is cold and the drink is slightly diluted.
Twist the orange peel over the drink to express its oils, drop it in, and add the cherry.
tips: Most published versions (The Kitchn, Difford's Guide) use 2 oz bourbon; this one runs 2 1/2 oz with only 1/4 oz syrup, so it is stronger and drier.
No demerara syrup on hand: stir 1 tsp demerara sugar with 2 tsp water in the glass until nearly dissolved and use that in its place (The Kitchn's method).

references.title: Old-Fashioned
references.usedFor: demerara sugar and water shortcut, expressing the peel
